children: Overview
US community bank's unaudited fiscal Q4 net income rose sharply year-over-year
Q4 net interest income increased, driven by higher interest and fees on loans and securities
Company's Q4 non-interest income declined, mainly due to lower miscellaneous income
Outlook
Company did not provide specific guidance or outlook for the current quarter or year
Result Drivers
LOAN GROWTH - Co said higher interest and fees on loans drove Q4 net interest income increase
SECURITIES INCOME - Co said higher interest on securities contributed to Q4 net interest income growth
LOWER NON-INTEREST EXPENSE - Co said Q4 non-interest expense fell, mainly due to reduced salaries, benefits and professional services
